title: My working schedule
subtitle: Review your current schedule and plan schedules for upcoming periods.
monthHint: The calendar shows 3 months from the selected date.

zoneA.title: Current schedule
zoneA.callout: Manage existing bookings and availability here.
zoneA.scopeCustom: Custom range in Zone A (pick on the calendar)
zoneA.cancelReasonHint: The patient will see this in the cancellation notification
zoneA.vacationLockedHint: We recommend cancelling appointments first so those dates become available.
zoneA.vacationReadyHint: Empty days are ready — you can mark them as vacation.
zoneA.vacationRemoveHint: The selected days are already marked as vacation.

zoneB.title: Future schedule
zoneB.intro: Set up your schedule for the next 3 months.
zoneB.periodHint: Starts the day after Zone A and runs to the end of the allowed horizon (3 months).
zoneB.workingDaysHint: Choose the days you regularly work.
zoneB.exceptionsHint: Dates that differ from your regular schedule.
zoneB.exceptionsPickHint: Click a Zone B date on the calendar to mark it as a day off.
zoneB.exceptionsAlreadyRegularOff: This day is already a regular day off from your working-days rule.
zoneB.exceptionsAlreadyAdded: This date is already in exceptions.
zoneB.priceHint: Applies from the first day of Zone B · profile shows bookable price
zoneB.promoHint: Shown to patients instead of the base price while active. Never charged in-app.
zoneB.selectRangeFirst: First select Zone B days on the calendar — changes apply only to them.

plannedSchedules.title: Planned schedules
plannedSchedules.hint: Saved future ranges. Click to highlight the period on the calendar.

important.title: Good to know
important.b1: Visit format (offline / online / both) is set in Zone B and affects what patients see.
important.b2: Zone B changes do not alter existing bookings in Zone A.
important.b3: Cancel individual visits from the doctor day screen; use this page for bulk cancel in Zone A.

modals.bulkBody: Patients will get an in-app notification. The doctor is the cancelling party. This action cannot be undone for these visits.
modals.bulkWarning: Nothing is cancelled silently. Confirmation is required — patients will see that the doctor cancelled the visit.
modals.vacationABody: Vacation can only be marked on days with no appointments. Patients will not be able to book those dates.
modals.vacationANote: Hours stay frozen. Vacation only marks the day as off — patients cannot book.
modals.vacationRemoveBody: These days will become bookable again for patients (within Zone A).
modals.vacationRemoveNote: Working hours stay the same — only the day-off mark is removed.
modals.vacationBBody: There are no bookings in Zone B — you can plan free days.
modals.vacationBNote: Changes apply only to Zone B. Working hours and appointments in Zone A stay unchanged.
modals.weekendsMarkNote: These days will show as vacation / day off on the calendar. Other days stay unchanged.
modals.saveBBody: Working hours, working days, format and price apply to the Zone B period (<bold>{{range}}</bold>). Exceptions are saved separately.
modals.saveBNote: Settings apply to the entire Zone B period. Existing Zone A visits stay unchanged.

saveError: Could not save Zone B. Check the fields and try again.
saveErrorOutsideZoneB: The period must be inside Zone B (through {{end}}).
saveErrorNoPeriod: Select a Zone B period on the calendar or in the period fields.
vacationError: Could not save vacation. Check that those days have no appointments.
